heading: Presumption of existence of jurisdiction
lead: In any action to enforce the requirements of this chapter respecting a device, tobacco product, food, drug, or cosmetic the connection with interstate commerce required for jurisdiction in such action shall be presumed to exist.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2009—Pub. L. 111–31 inserted “tobacco product,” after “device,”. 1997—Pub. L. 105–115 substituted “a device, food, drug, or cosmetic” for “a device”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1997 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 105–115 effective 90 days after Nov. 21, 1997, except as otherwise provided, see section 501 of Pub. L. 105–115, set out as a note under section 321 of this title.
